title: Job Interview
goals: mengenali tahapan **job interview**: salam, perkenalan, pertanyaan inti, dan penutup
menjawab pertanyaan umum: [[Tell me about yourself.]], [[Why do you want this job?]], [[What are your strengths?]]
memakai ungkapan sopan dan profesional dalam wawancara
menceritakan pengalaman dan kemampuan dengan **simple past** dan **present perfect**
berlatih dialog wawancara kerja dari awal sampai akhir

lesson.text: Setelah surat lamaran diterima, langkah berikutnya adalah **wawancara kerja** (*job interview*). Pewawancara ingin tahu siapa kamu, apa kemampuanmu, dan mengapa kamu cocok. Dengan latihan, jawaban yang **jelas, jujur, dan sopan** akan membuatmu percaya diri.

lesson.title: 1. Tahapan wawancara
table: [[Good morning. Thank you for seeing me.]]
[[Please tell me about yourself.]] / [[My name is Dina Putri.]]
[[Why do you want to work here?]]
[[Could you tell me more about the job?]]
[[Thank you for your time. I look forward to hearing from you.]]

lesson.title: 2. Pertanyaan umum dan cara menjawab
table: [[I graduated from SMK Negeri 1 in 2025. I enjoy working with people.]]
[[I want to learn and use my skills in a professional team.]]
[[I am responsible, punctual, and a quick learner.]]
[[Sometimes I am too careful, but I am learning to work faster.]]
[[Yes, I did an internship at a travel agency for three months.]]
[[Yes, I can. I stay calm and make a plan.]]
[[Where do you see yourself in five years?]]
[[I hope to become a skilled and trusted employee.]]

items.ex: He is a good team player.
What is the salary for this position?
The probation period is three months.
My achievement was winning a contest.
The company will train new staff.

lesson.title: 4. Ungkapan sopan dan profesional
table: [[Could you repeat the question, please?]] / [[I'm sorry, could you say that again?]]
[[I am able to ...]] / [[I am good at ...]] / [[I can ...]]
[[I have worked as ... for ...]] / [[I was responsible for ...]]
[[What are the working hours?]] / [[Is there any training?]]

lesson.title: Hindari jawaban kasual dan berlebihan
lesson.text: Jangan jawab dengan [[Yeah]], [[Nope]], atau [[Whatever]]. Gunakan [[Yes]], [[No]], [[Certainly]]. Jangan berbohong dan jangan menjelekkan tempat kerja lama. Jawab singkat, jelas, disertai **contoh**.

lesson.title: 5. Tense yang dipakai
table: [[I worked at a cafe last year.]]

lines.en: Good morning, Dina. Please have a seat.
Good morning, Mr. Adi. Thank you for seeing me.
lines.id: Selamat pagi, Pak Adi. Terima kasih sudah menerima saya.

lines.en: I graduated from SMK Negeri 1 Bandung in 2025. I did an internship at a travel agency for three months, and I enjoy working with people.
lines.id: Saya lulus dari SMK Negeri 1 Bandung tahun 2025. Saya magang di biro perjalanan selama tiga bulan, dan saya senang bekerja dengan orang.

lines.en: Why do you want to work here?
lines.id: Mengapa kamu ingin bekerja di sini?

lines.en: Because your company is well known for good service, and I want to learn from a professional team.
lines.id: Karena perusahaan Anda terkenal dengan pelayanan yang baik, dan saya ingin belajar dari tim profesional.

lines.en: I am responsible, punctual, and a quick learner.
lines.id: Saya bertanggung jawab, tepat waktu, dan cepat belajar.

lines.en: Do you have any questions for me?
lines.id: Apakah kamu punya pertanyaan untuk saya?

lines.en: Yes. What are the working hours, and is there any training for new staff?
lines.id: Ya. Berapa jam kerjanya, dan apakah ada pelatihan untuk staf baru?

lines.en: The working hours are from eight to four, and we train new staff for two weeks.
lines.id: Jam kerjanya pukul delapan sampai empat, dan kami melatih staf baru selama dua minggu.

lines.en: Thank you for your time. I look forward to hearing from you.
lines.id: Terima kasih atas waktu Anda. Saya menantikan kabar dari Anda.

lines.en: We will contact you next week.

lesson.title: Persiapan wawancara
lesson.text: Pelajari perusahaan, latih jawaban untuk pertanyaan umum, datang **tepat waktu**, berpakaian rapi, tersenyum, dan lihat mata pewawancara. Gunakan pola **jawaban + contoh**: [[I am responsible. For example, I finished every task on time during my internship.]]

items: Tahapan: salam, perkenalan, pertanyaan inti, bertanya balik, penutup.
Pertanyaan umum: [[Tell me about yourself.]], [[Why do you want this job?]], [[What are your strengths?]]
Jawab dengan **jelas, jujur, sopan**, sertakan contoh nyata.
Tense: simple present (sifat), simple past (pengalaman), present perfect (sampai sekarang), will (komitmen).
Akhiri dengan [[Thank you for your time.]]
